title: Categories
description: What customers book: car classes with photos, specs and prices

help.title: About categories
help.overview: Customers book a category, not a specific car. The system assigns a free car of that category when the booking is made.

sections.title: On this page
items: Prices: the daily rate applies unless a season covers the day; a weekend rate applies on local Saturdays and Sundays; a weekly rate is used for whole weeks when it is cheaper.
Turn off 'Shown on the website' to keep a category for staff bookings only.
Changing a price never changes bookings already made.
